en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-74 Hamzih ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alavi - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Amr ibn Uthman, on the authority of Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hamid,on the authority of Abil Hassan - the first (MGB) that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said, “

This life is a prison for a believer. The grave is a refugee for a believer, and Paradise is a believer’s Final Abode. This world is Paradise for an infidel. The grave is an infidel’s prison and the Fire is his place of Final Abode.”
